SRC-010:R0001.text: Freeze a protocol semantic baseline before shortening any normative prose, covering phases, transitions, commands, normalization, STATE, ticket and next-action forms, vocabularies, safety gates, checkpointing, authority, recovery, goal/autonomy, continue-to-improve fallthrough, and planned HUSH precedence, with current owner and test evidence for each fact.

SRC-010:R0002.text: Preserve golden outputs for continue, cc, ccc, ship, improve, compound commands, recovery, and dry-run, and require the existing validator, scenarios, and tests to be green before compression.

SRC-010:R0003.text: Continue fallback may run only after existing Work is exhausted, must resume an existing Improve cycle, and must never create an unbounded Improve carousel.

SRC-010:R0004.text: Create saipen/REGISTRY.json as the sole machine-owned registry for closed executable facts, including phases, legal transitions, canonical commands, aliases, shortcuts, confusable normalization, next-action forms, and closed vocabularies, while excluding philosophy and narrative reasoning.

SRC-010:R0005.text: commands.py and validators must consume the registry or runtime structures instead of parsing English prose, and rewriting command prose must leave behavior outputs byte-identical.

SRC-010:R0006.text: Introduce stable Rule IDs only for cross-referenced rules and enforce One Rule equals One Owner, with references replacing normative restatements and validation rejecting duplicate owners.

SRC-010:R0007.text: Extract the command surface to saipen/COMMANDS.md as a compact input-to-action-to-special-rule-to-Rule-ID map, preserving all public command names, compound parsing, Unicode twins, STOP_ON_FAILURE, HUSH syntax, and continue-to-improve semantics.

SRC-010:R0008.text: Compress CORE.md into a normative kernel containing authority, essential state and ownership models, the state machine, deterministic priority, completion truth, and high-level recovery invariants, moving narrative incident history out of normative rules without weakening MUST or MUST NOT branches.

SRC-010:R0009.text: Compress BOOT.md into a cold-start read-and-execute order that routes detailed semantics through Rule IDs and owner documents instead of repeating command, source, reply-language, identity, and recovery contracts.

SRC-010:R0010.text: Keep all 16 phases and their state graph; compress each phase by the delta principle into Entry, Reads, Actions, Exit, Forbidden, Evidence, and Rule refs without restating shared protocol rules.

SRC-010:R0011.text: Compress MAINTENANCE.md, OPS.md, and IMPROVE.md through lifecycle state, trigger, and termination tables plus Rule IDs while retaining edge cases and avoiding aggressive cuts to already-structured mechanical contracts.

SRC-010:R0012.text: Create saipen/EXECUTION.md as the single owner for default narration, HUSH activation, tool-first behavior, silence lock, mandatory-output exceptions, final report limits, and audit interaction, with CORE, STYLE, and COMMANDS retaining only their distinct precedence, voice, and syntax responsibilities.

SRC-010:R0013.text: Move every CONFORMANCE scenario row to a machine corpus such as tests/conformance_cases.jsonl with id, rule_id, setup, and expected result, retaining all scenarios while shrinking CONFORMANCE.md to a generated or corpus-checked debugging index outside production loading.

SRC-010:R0014.text: Classify and remove phrase-based validator checks: semantic invariants must be tested through registry, parsed structure, or runtime behavior, while only genuine exact markers may retain wording checks.

SRC-010:R0015.text: Add tools/protocol_budget.py and CI budgets for cold, ordinary continue, command resolution, ordinary phase, ship/improve, routinely loaded documents, and production exclusion of CONFORMANCE, measuring real load profiles as well as total bytes.

SRC-010:R0016.text: Migrate only in small semantic-preserving waves in the order registry and decoupling, COMMANDS, CORE, BOOT, phases, maintenance family, CONFORMANCE, final dedupe; each wave must pass registry equality, validator, scenarios, unit, routing, hostile recovery, source, continue/improve, and golden semantic diff before deleting duplicate prose.

SRC-010:R0017.text: Target approximately 250 to 325 KB of human-readable protocol and approximately 20 to 45 KB of routine relevant law, with specialized ship/improve profiles up to 55 KB, without minifying Markdown or counting the machine conformance corpus as production prose.
